topic: Actual applicant claim capabilities and completed-attempt integrity
observedProblem: The holder claim handler ignored its request body, including delivery destination and Canvas consent values, although this Rust claim path did not perform those selections.
Concurrent calls sharing an already reserved attempt could receive the same offer, but the later completion failed with AttemptChanged after the first completion removed the active attempt.
A late NoActiveFlow provider error could mark an already completed and reconciled claim BLOCKED and move its updated_at backwards.
The production handler already reused a pending unexpired offer, contrary to a UI expectation that opening or changing consent always generated a fresh offer.

claimContract.capabilityIsNotEligibility: Existing status, claim_state, blocker and offer expiry still govern whether the application may be claimed.

completedAttemptIntegrity.concurrencyBoundary: Pre-reservation snapshot conflicts can still return 409. This is safe completed-attempt convergence, not a guarantee that every simultaneous request is deduplicated. The UI must share its own pending claim request for the same application, holder and organization.

remainingBoundaries: No live beta, deployed Rust service, native wallet, physical device, KMS publication, or external Canvas delivery was exercised.
Delivery destination selection and Canvas consent are explicitly unsupported by the holder claim path; existing issuer publication modules do not establish holder-side consent handling.

No new credential revocation, offer cancellation, historical data repair, application deletion, or native resource retirement implementation is included. Native server retirement remains NOT_PERFORMED.
No guarantee is made that all concurrent pre-reservation calls succeed; a changed snapshot remains a safe conflict.
No Cargo manifest, dependency, lockfile, frozen route-inventory or external side-effect change was made.
